response.reason: The clause from Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 Art. 22(1) explicitly requires the indication of the quantity of an ingredient when it appears in the name of the food (as with 'chickpea' and 'sesame paste' in 'Chickpea dip with sesame paste'). The verdict correctly applies this requirement, noting that both ingredients are named and their percentages are provided, thus satisfying the QUID requirement as per the cited clause.
